name: Dialog
description: A lightweight confirmation dialog for simple confirm/cancel actions. Simpler than Modal, designed for quick decisions like deletions or confirmations. Supports a danger variant for destructive actions.

notes: Uses role='alertdialog' and aria-modal='true' to announce as a confirmation dialog.
aria-labelledby connects the dialog to the title element.
aria-describedby connects the dialog to the body content.
Body scroll is locked while the dialog is open.
Focus is trapped inside via FocusTrap and restored to the trigger on close.
Clicking the Overlay closes the dialog.

onClose.description: Called when the dialog should close (escape, overlay click, or cancel).

onConfirm.description: Called when the confirm button is clicked.

children.description: Body content of the dialog, typically a confirmation message.

confirmLabel.description: Label for the confirm action button.

cancelLabel.description: Label for the cancel action button.

variant.description: Visual variant. Use 'danger' for destructive confirmations.

do: Use 'danger' variant when confirming destructive actions like deletion.
Keep dialog content brief — one or two sentences.
Provide clear, specific button labels (e.g., 'Delete' instead of 'Confirm').
dont: Do not use Dialog for complex forms — use Modal instead.
Do not nest a Dialog inside another Dialog or Modal.
Do not use for informational content that does not require a decision.
